# Junseo Ha

> Software engineer based in Seoul, South Korea, building LLM applications, retrieval pipelines, and web experiences. Currently an AI developer and LLM project lead in the Republic of Korea Navy. Computer science graduate of Georgia Institute of Technology.

## Portfolio

- [Full plain-text portfolio](https://junununseo.com/portfolio.txt): Introduction, education, engineering experience, all four projects, skills, and contact information. No JavaScript or interaction required.
- [Website](https://junununseo.com/): The same portfolio in semantic HTML, with ProfilePage and Person JSON-LD. Text is present in the initial response; the optional entrance animation does not generate content.
- [Portrait](https://junununseo.com/assets/junseo-ha.jpg): Original photograph of Junseo Ha. The website’s playful “Generate an image” control replaces the introduction with this photo; “Hide image” restores the introduction. This interaction does not call an image-generation service.

## Sections

- [Education](https://junununseo.com/#education): B.S. Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence & Media, Georgia Institute of Technology, January 2022–December 2024. Overall GPA: 3.77/4.0; major GPA: 3.87/4.0. Georgia State University, Atlanta, GA, August 2019–December 2021: majored in Computer Science. Overall GPA: 4.07/4.3; major GPA: 4.08/4.3.
- [Experience](https://junununseo.com/#experience): Republic of Korea Navy, AI Developer (Military Service) and LLM Project Lead (June 2025–present), leading a Navy-wide LLM assistant and representing a seven-developer team; Aimgonna (January–June 2025), improving routing accuracy from 70% to 92% and category-match scores from 38% to 52%; and NextIts (May–August 2023).
- [Selected projects](https://junununseo.com/#projects): Anchorive; ARC reasoning agent, which achieved the highest class score at 3× the runner-up; TerraVision; and New York Taxi Data Analysis.
- [Skills](https://junununseo.com/#skills): Java, Python, C, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript; Vue, React, LangGraph, LangSmith, FastAPI, Pydantic, vLLM; MySQL, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, HTML, CSS, Unity, Android Studio, Git, Docker. Korean (native) and English (professional).
